body:
Part of General UI Polish (feature item 9). On the board, selecting a card that is already selected (or double-clicking it) should scroll the page to its detail.

- In `solace_board`, a `Select` for the already-selected card, and a double-click on any card, sends a scroll-to-detail signal: the detail band from task 812bda5e156af79a expands if collapsed and receives focus/scroll.
- The board's `Select` message gains the "same card again" case; the double-click arrives as a second click within the click window, handled as the same signal.
- Scrolling is a frontend behavior in `priv/app.js`/`shell.mjs` (the board page's shadow host), driven by a data attribute the board sets, so Gleam stays pure.

**Tests:** board view tests assert the signal on re-select and double-click; the frontend test checks the scroll handler fires when the attribute is set.
title: ui: Re-select scrolls to detail
